messages.title: Game directory
messages.subtitle: Find your Stardew Valley installation to prepare for mod management.
messages.manualHint: You can also paste an absolute path. Choose the game root, not the Mods or saves folder.
messages.coverage: Checks Steam libraries and common GOG locations, including custom Steam libraries.
messages.emptyHint: Check that the game is installed and its drive is mounted, or choose its installation folder manually.
messages.readyHint: This directory will be checked again the next time you open the app.
messages.smapiHint: Use the SMAPI panel below the selected directory to install, update or remove it.
messages.warnings: Some locations could not be checked ({count})
messages.selectionMissing: The previously selected directory is unavailable. Check its drive or select another directory.
messages.storageError: Preferences could not be read or saved. You can continue, but your selection may not survive a restart.

smapi.title: SMAPI
smapi.statusHint: SMAPI is required to run mods. The installer is downloaded from the official GitHub release and verified with SHA-256 before anything is written.
smapi.uninstalledNotice: SMAPI removed and the original launcher restored
smapi.launcherReplaced: The game launcher now starts SMAPI, so launching through Steam works as usual.
smapi.launcherKept: Windows keeps the original launcher. To start with mods from Steam, set StardewModdingAPI.exe as a launch option.
smapi.noGame: Select a game directory above first.

uninstallConfirm.title: Remove SMAPI from this directory?
uninstallConfirm.hint: The SMAPI files are deleted, the original launcher is restored, and the bundled mods plus every file the install created are removed.
uninstallConfirm.removeMods: Also delete every mod in the Mods folder
uninstallConfirm.removeModsWarning: This cannot be undone: everything inside Mods will be deleted.

smapi.uninstallSummary: Removed {removed} items and cleared {mods} mods from Mods

log.title: Game log
log.hint: Shows the log SMAPI wrote the last time the game ran.
log.missing: No log yet — start the game through SMAPI once.
log.truncated: The log is long; only the newest part is shown.

errors.directoryUnreadable: Cannot read this directory. Check the path, drive connection and access permissions.
errors.invalidGameDirectory: The game launcher or Content folder is missing. Choose the game root directory.
errors.steamMetadataInvalid: A Steam installation record is invalid. Other locations were still checked.
errors.steamMetadataUnreadable: Cannot read a Steam installation record.
errors.registryUnreadable: Cannot read some Windows installation records.
errors.platformUnsupported: Automatic discovery is not available on this system. Choose the game folder manually.
errors.discoveryFailed: Directory discovery failed. Retry or choose a folder manually.
errors.invalidResponse: The application returned an unexpected data format. Please restart it.
errors.desktopRequired: Use the Lingrid desktop app to find game directories. Browser previews cannot access your local game.
errors.smapiUnsupportedPlatform: Automatic SMAPI installation is not available on this system.
errors.smapiUnavailable: Cannot reach the network. Check your connection and retry.
errors.smapiReleaseUnavailable: Cannot read the latest SMAPI release information. Check your connection and retry.
errors.smapiReleaseInvalid: The SMAPI release information had an unexpected format. Nothing was installed.
errors.smapiChecksumMismatch: The downloaded SMAPI installer failed verification. Installation was stopped.
errors.smapiArchiveUnreadable: Cannot read the downloaded SMAPI installer.
errors.smapiArchiveInvalid: The SMAPI installer content is invalid. Nothing was installed.
errors.smapiInstallFailed: Installing SMAPI failed. The game directory was restored to its previous state.
errors.smapiNotInstalled: SMAPI was not found, so it cannot be uninstalled.
errors.smapiGameFilesMissing: The game directory has no Stardew Valley.deps.json, so SMAPI cannot be installed.
errors.smapiRecordFailed: The SMAPI installation record could not be saved.
errors.smapiLogUnavailable: Cannot locate the game's log folder.
errors.modsUnreadable: Cannot read the game's Mods folder.
errors.modArchiveInvalid: The archive has no readable mod inside it.
errors.modInstallFailed: Installing the mod failed. Check the archive and folder permissions.
errors.modFolderTaken: A folder with that name already exists in Mods. Remove it first.
errors.modFolderInvalid: That mod folder name is not valid.
errors.modNotFound: The mod folder is no longer there. Refresh the list.
errors.modRenameFailed: Cannot rename the mod folder. Close the game and retry.
errors.modRemoveFailed: Cannot delete the mod folder. Close the game and retry.
errors.nexusUnavailable: Cannot reach Nexus Mods. Check your connection and retry.
errors.nexusQueryFailed: Nexus Mods rejected the search. Retry in a moment.
errors.nexusKeyMissing: Add your Nexus API key in Settings first.
errors.nexusKeyNotSaved: The Nexus API key could not be saved.
errors.nexusDownloadDenied: Nexus refused the download. Check your API key, or use the link from the website.
errors.nxmInvalid: That is not a valid nxm:// mod link.
errors.nxmNeedsFile: That link points at a mod, not a file. Open the mod's Files tab and use the Mod Manager Download link of a specific file (right-click it and copy the address).
errors.nxmUnsupportedGame: That link belongs to a different game.
errors.nexusNeedsGame: A mod link arrived, but no game directory is selected yet. Pick one on the Game directory page, then click the link again.
errors.unexpected: The operation could not be completed. Retry or inspect the technical details.

nexus.nxmHint: Paste the nxm:// link that Nexus gives you when you press “Mod Manager Download”.
nexus.keyRequired: Add your Nexus API key in Settings before downloading.
nexus.apiKeyHint: Needed to download from Nexus. Create one on your Nexus account page under “API”. Free accounts work too.
nexus.title: Browse Nexus
nexus.description: Search Stardew Valley mods on Nexus Mods. Opening a mod takes you to its page there.
nexus.searchPlaceholder: Name, or a mod id like 5815
nexus.hint: An empty search lists the newest mods; a bare number looks up that mod id, the form people use when sharing mods. Searching is anonymous; downloading happens on the Nexus website.
nexus.emptyHint: Try another term, or clear the field to browse the newest mods.

mods.title: Mods
mods.description: Manage the mods installed in the selected game directory.
mods.removeWarning: The whole mod folder is deleted. Settings you changed inside it are lost too.
mods.emptyHint: Install one from an archive, or drop it into the Mods folder yourself.
mods.noGame: Select a game directory on the Game directory page first.

settings.description: Customize your Lingrid interface and preferences.
settings.languageHint: Changes take effect immediately and are kept for your next session.
settings.themeModeHint: Follow the system setting, or keep light or dark.
settings.accentHint: Used for buttons, highlights and selected items.

overview.description: View your game directory and current environment.
overview.chooseHint: Choose an installation on the Game directory page.
